style: Original river workshop storybook illustrations. Forest green, sage, cream and muted gold. Otter Lada and kingfisher Flik. No apples or baskets.

scenes.workshop: Lada introduces the silent instrument, Flik listens.
scenes.jetty: Lada guides an empty raft; Flik indicates the bank.
scenes.stream: Lada joins willow frame pieces; Flik helps.
scenes.concert: Lada plays the restored instrument; Flik conducts.

derivatives: WebP encoding and thumbnail sizing only. Source images retained.
